name: ModelVariant835_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant835_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (one more orb joins each frame up to the command's count; each flies from a model part as a textured sprite with a fading gradient trail towards a spread point in front of the opposing slot, then fades, bursts into a growing quartered flash and throws animated sparks while the ambient light dims and recovers); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request, scatters the sparks and packs two texture images, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0 before the start time, 4 while the first orb has arrived but not the last, 1 once when the last orb arrives, 2 once the light has recovered and the last flash and sparks are done and 0 otherwise; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-852 and 949 images build it from the same source through french_model_variant/variant852_entry.c with VERSION_FRENCH and the US layout. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
